D009-D011_h001.question:
Honestly, I'm not really sure why I'm here. My manager at the cosmetics store suggested I talk to someone. For about a year now, I've just felt… empty. It's like a heavy blanket over everything. Even when we hit our sales targets, which used to be a huge deal for me, I just feel nothing. Thinking feels like wading through mud; my brain just gets tired so fast. There have been times, a few months ago actually, when things got really dark. I even started looking up ways to just… stop feeling this way, if that makes sense.

But then, for the past month, it's been the opposite. I have so much energy, I can barely sit still at work. I'm buzzing, talking a mile a minute, bouncing between customers and restocking, not feeling tired even if I've only slept a couple of hours. My team says I'm a bit snappier than usual, and I guess I do get annoyed easily these days. It’s not causing problems at work, but it’s definitely a shift. It’s mostly just this intense feeling of restlessness, like I have to be doing something constantly. It's confusing because sometimes I feel totally on edge during these bursts of energy, like I'm waiting for something bad to happen, but mostly I just feel really wound up.
D009-D011_h001.options:
A. Generalized Anxiety Disorder
    B. Adjustment Disorder
    C. Persistent Depressive Disorder
    D. Bipolar II Disorder
D009-D011_h001.answer: D & A. Bipolar II Disorder & Generalized Anxiety Disorder
